approvers: None, I decide alone, but the main contractor would have to allow it on site
reason: I spend about 1,340 euro a year on glazing damage and pay it from the job contingency. ACHV is a contractor too, and I don't want a competitor on my site or looking at my programme. At 19 euro per m2 the cost would be many times what damage costs me today.
objection: A competitor on my site who sees my programme and my customers, at a price far above the damage I actually pay for.
instead: Carry on as now: no protection, clean or replace at snagging from the contingency. I might ask my own fitters to tape or film the worst frames.
would_change_my_mind: A main contractor that makes protection mandatory and pays for it, or a supplier that is not a contractor and sells only the product at a few euro per m2.
